translated_title: The 152 Hospital Projects Planned for the Six-Year Term Advance, with an Investment of 181 Billion Pesos: Sheinbaum
original_title: Avanzan los 152 proyectos hospitalarios proyectados para el sexenio con una inversión de 181 mil mdp: Sheinbaum
author: Alonso Urrutia and Lilian Hernández
meta_description: Of the 152 projects, 50 are brand-new hospitals; the plan adds 13,300 census beds by 2030, more than triple the neoliberal era's 4,300.
